heroBody: Our mission is to develop artificial general intelligence (AGI), advance MEA Cloud Desktops, and build PeopleWelcome—a social media platform for humans and machines. We aim to make intelligence, computing, and connection more accessible, empowering people and machines to learn, create, and collaborate.

visionTitle: A personal desktop, without a physical box.
visionBody: The legacy concept pairs virtualized computing resources with the devices people already use.
capabilityBody: Heraldic’s legacy materials describe a desktop-as-a-service model that uses virtual hardware to extend what an older or lower-powered device can do.
capabilityOneBody: Create additional capacity without installing physical components.
capabilityTwoBody: Support work on an older PC or lightweight device through a hosted desktop.
capabilityThreeBody: Use an operating environment and applications from wherever an internet connection is available.
systemsTitle: Three original paths into the cloud.
systemsBody: The former product lineup is retained here as a record of the MEA vision, without storefront, purchase, signup, or affiliate links.
eleetBody: Originally envisioned as a powerful personal cloud desktop for graphics-intensive work, helping a local device stay cool and light.
powerBody: A flexible cloud PC concept for office work and entertainment, intended to be reachable across desktop and mobile devices.
newbieBody: The original free, lightweight Linux concept centered on web use, creativity, study, and access to computing for more people.
privacyTitle: Trust should be part of the architecture.
privacyBodyOne: The original MEA FAQ emphasized making personal computing harder to compromise and keeping the user—not surveillance—at the center of the experience.
privacyBodyTwo: Today, this site carries that commitment forward: no trackers, ads, affiliate storefronts, or third-party embeds. Messages you submit to Artem AI are sent to OpenAI to generate a reply.
missionBody: Heraldic’s mission brings together the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI), MEA Cloud Desktops, and PeopleWelcome, a social media platform for humans and machines. Our goal is to expand access to intelligence, computing, and meaningful connection so people and machines can learn, create, and collaborate.
missionQuote: “Ability is not a commodity. It should be available to all who seek it.”
closingNote: This refreshed site presents the historical Mise En Abyme vision in a modern, privacy-first interface. There are no active beta, account, sales, or payment flows.
